meta.description: Gives paths and geometry a color: brown stems, green leaves, white petals. A path gets a color at every point, read with alpha from its base to its tip, so a mix_color with a curve of alpha makes a gradient. A geometry gets one at every vertex, alpha goes from its base to its tip and alpha across from its middle to its edge. Paths and geometry without a color keep the viewer's material.

plant.description: The paths or geometry to color, a leaf or a list of them from a join node. Everything else passes through as it is.

color.description: The color, set here or from mix_color. It is read for every path, with path_info and random per path, and along it, so a curve of alpha into the factor of mix_color shades a stem from its base to its tip.

depth.description: How many of the deepest levels of paths get the color, 1 colors only the deepest.
